scenes.narration: This is a simulated robot assembly bench. It has one arm, a turntable with a vise and pincers, an iron that feeds its own {solder|sodder}, a tool rack, and a tray of parts. The arm brings a {lead|leed} to a {lead|leed}. A pincer holds it, and the turntable brings the joint to the iron. Watch it build a whole blinker circuit, at four times speed.
